title: OpenAI's nonprofit will keep control of the company
summary: OpenAI announced that the nonprofit that founded it will stay in control. Its for-profit arm will become a public benefit corporation, a kind of company that must weigh its mission alongside profits, and the nonprofit will be a large shareholder in it. OpenAI said it made the decision after hearing from civic leaders and talking with the attorneys general of Delaware and California.
why_it_matters: OpenAI's structure decides who has the final say over one of the most influential AI companies. This keeps a nonprofit in charge whose stated mission is making sure AGI benefits all of humanity.
